bugs.title: Save Changes never saves the profile
bugs.description: Clicking Save Changes calls the EditUser cloud function. The browser blocks the request with a CORS error and the page then throws a React error. The user sees no success or error message, the form stays in edit mode, and a reload brings back the old values. Display Name and Date of Birth are the only editable fields, so editing a profile does nothing.

testCases.title: TC024 - Verify Save Changes does not persist a new Display Name (bug)
TC025 - Verify Save Changes with no edits gives no feedback and stays in edit mode (bug)
TC026 - Verify Save Changes does not persist a new Date of Birth (bug)

bugs.notes: The CORS error is likely a server or environment setting on the cloud function rather than a page bug. Reproduced on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

bugs.title: No link to the Profile page anywhere in the UI
bugs.description: /profile works when typed into the address bar, but nothing links to it. The sidebar has no Profile item, and the top-right account menu lists only the name, email and Logout. Clicking the name, email or avatar in that menu does nothing. The Android app opens Profile from the same avatar.

testCases.title: TC008 - Verify no link to the Profile page exists in the UI (bug)

bugs.title: Cancel leaves the typed text in Display Name
bugs.description: After typing in Display Name and clicking Cancel, the form returns to read-only but the field still shows the typed text instead of the saved value.

testCases.title: TC016 - Verify Cancel leaves the typed text in Display Name (bug)

bugs.notes: Stale screen state only. Nothing is saved and a reload restores the real value.

bugs.title: Empty Display Name is accepted with no error

testCases.title: TC017 - Verify an empty Display Name shows no error and Save stays enabled (bug)

bugs.title: Display Name has no maximum length

testCases.title: TC018 - Verify Display Name has no maximum length (bug)

bugs.title: Display Name keeps leading and trailing spaces

testCases.title: TC019 - Verify Display Name keeps leading and trailing spaces (bug)
